verdict.rationale: Azure's official docs show exact onboarding commands, such as the Homebrew install for the Azure CLI, along with a free account option and marketing copy about quickly creating cloud apps. However, no evidence shows an official quickstart that takes a developer from zero to a running deployed service with step-by-step deploy commands. Community reports of setup complexity (comm-20) temper confidence but do not concretely contradict any quickstart. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end deploy quickstart with exact commands, evidence of time-to-first-deploy under an hour, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quickstart experience.
